parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Another card is pivoted at point P. The weight of the card is 1.4 N and acts through a point 20 cm from P. Fig. 3.2 shows the arrangement. Fig. 3.2 Calculate the moment of the weight of the card about point P. moment of weight = ................................................. N cm [3]

ms.label: 3(b)
ms.text:
(moment of weight =) weight × distance (of direction of force from pivot)
(moment =) 1.4 × 20
28 (N cm)
